# Langeland

Langeland is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Database for Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1] [^src2]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, focusing heavily on anticoagulation therapies, safety monitoring, and the prevention of ischemic strokes [^src1] [^src2].

In the context of the report, Langeland is noted for its performance on Indicator 4b, which measures compliance with safety practices regarding the use of DOAC (Direct Oral Anticoagulant) medications [^src1]. The municipality achieved a 95.4% compliance rate, successfully meeting the standard in 333 out of 349 cases, with a 95% confidence interval of 92.7% to 97.4% [^src1]. This achievement distinguishes Langeland as one of the smaller municipalities to reach full standard fulfillment for this specific indicator [^src1]. Furthermore, the data shows a 93.8% rate (288 out of 307 cases) for an associated metric evaluated under the same indicator [^src1].

The annual report also documents Langeland's metrics for other key clinical indicators, such as the early initiation of anticoagulation treatment [^src2]. For these specific measurements, Langeland recorded a 0.4% rate (with a confidence interval of 0.1–1.6%), though the exact case counts are suppressed in the publication and represented by "#" symbols to protect patient anonymity [^src2].
